resources.string: Needed to keep screen mirroring process alive in a foreground service.
Needed to stop screen mirroring when driving. Android may show this as a location request, but LMonitor receives no information besides the vehicle speed.
Immediately request screen mirroring permissions when opening the app in Android Auto.
Prevent the screen from turning off while mirroring is active. The screen will still dim when idle.

Forces the whole phone into landscape orientation via a system setting. Needs the special "Modify system settings" permission, granted once on a separate screen. Turn off to restore normal auto-rotation.

Fully release screen capture when Android Auto disconnects. Turn off to keep the capture session running in the background so mirroring can resume without asking for permission again, at the cost of a persistent notification and battery usage while disconnected.
